prompt: Create a polished simple desktop WEBSITE MOCKUP edge to edge landscape 1536x1024. Pasha Barbershop, Plano. Black #141414, antique matte gold #C9AD69, warm white only. Elegant sturdy Roman serif display with humanist sans UI. No photos, fezzes, hats, clichéd barber icons, fabricated awards or reviews. Bold compositional alternative within this black/gold identity: the first 580px is a full-width FLAT MATTE GOLD field with black lettering, one crisp black header line: PASHA BARBERSHOP at left, Services, Visit, and black Book on Booksy button at right. Main heading 'Turkish barbering.\nRight here in Plano.' is left aligned at a large confident 88px, with generous left margin; short plain body 'Haircuts, beard work, and grooming packages.' below. An architectural but purely flat thin black arch-frame stands behind a typographic P monogram on the far right as a QUIET secondary brand mark, no mosque or cultural caricature. At lower edge of gold field a horizontal utility line: '6921 Independence Pkwy, Suite 180' left and '(214) 501-3715' right. Beneath, full black ground with gold 'Make it your usual.' heading. Two long horizontal service rows visible, each combining service name, short description, price and booking link: 'Haircut / from $25' and 'Hair & beard / from $40'. More content continues below. Clear actual web navigation, accessible rectangular booking controls, no generic cards or numbered section labels. Use very disciplined space and one dominant gold field, pleasant local business tone.
name: The gold welcome
